newsitem.title: UK: BOE allots 2.5 bln stg on UK money market repos.
newsitem.headline: BOE allots 2.5 bln stg on UK money market repos.

text.p: The Bank of England allotted a total 2.5 billion stg in repurchase and secured loan facilities at 5-31/32 percent for the UK money market.
It is allotting 2.031 billion stg on the repo due on December 5, 6 and 9 and 469 million stg on the repos maturing November 21, 22 and 25.
That represents approximately 40 percent of the 5.118 billion stg of the four-week maturity applied for and 1.118 billion stg of the two-week maturity applied for, the Bank said.
The facilities open tomorrow, Friday and next Monday.
